Excellent Wedding Experience at Ocean Pearl Retreat
We hosted our wedding and reception at Hotel Ocean Pearl Retreat on 23rd & 24th November, and the experience was absolutely wonderful.

The food was outstanding, curated under Executive Chef Govind Rautela. Every dish was delicious, well-presented, and highly appreciated by our guests—definitely one of the highlights of our celebrations.

A special thanks to Event Manager Mr. Sanjay Rawat for his excellent coordination and smooth execution. His professionalism and attention to detail made the entire event stress-free and seamless.

Great hospitality, beautiful venue, and supportive staff. Highly recommended for weddings and special occasions.

Heartfelt thanks for the wonderful wedding catering of my Niece Prernna with Shantanu at Ocean Pearl Retreat Chhatarpur Delhi on 24th and 25th Dec’ 2025.
Dear Chef Gobind and Mahender Yadav Ji,
I’m writing to express our deepest gratitude for the outstanding food and impeccable service provided by your team at my Niece (Prernna & Shantanu) wedding
The entire event was a tremendous success, and your kitchen and service staff played a crucial role in making it so special, Chef every dish was a huge hit, and the presentation of everything was exquisite, our guest couldn’t stop raving about the delicious flavours and quality of the meal.
The service was equally exceptional, the attentiveness of entire team and managers on the floor ensured every guest felt welcomed and cared for, from the moment they arrived to the final farewell. The seamless coordination and professionalism made every thing run so smoothly, allowing us to fully enjoy the celebration.
Thank you for your flexibility and excellent communication during the planning, and for creating a stress-free experience. You helped to make the function a special day truly unforgettable
At last, but not the least we should not forget the support and guidance of Mr. Prakash the General and all the support staff like front office, engineering Mr Ramesh, Housekeeping
We will enthusiastically recommend Ocean Pearl to everyone we know
Warmest regards
Arun Bhatnagar
